items.name: Approved post publisher
items.desc: Publishes only the sheet rows you marked approved, once, then marks them posted.
items.guardrails: Posts only rows with status = approved, and writes status = posted right after to prevent duplicates.

items.name: Daily research brief
items.desc: Reads your chosen feeds each morning and sends the five items worth your time, each with its link.
items.guardrails: Every item keeps its original link so you can verify. The model picks, it does not rewrite facts.

items.name: Deploy failure alert
items.desc: Receives a CI or deploy webhook and sends a plain summary of what failed, with a link.
items.guardrails: Strips tokens and long logs before alerting. Sends only to your own chat.

items.name: Draft replies for approval
items.desc: Writes a reply draft in Gmail for each new email and pings you. It never sends.
items.guardrails: Output is a Gmail draft only. Sending stays a human click.

items.name: GitHub issue triage
items.desc: Labels new GitHub issues (bug, feature, question) and comments with what is missing. It never closes anything.
items.guardrails: Adds a label and one comment only. Issue text is treated as untrusted data.

items.name: Grounded cold outreach
items.desc: Reads each lead's real website and drafts an email using only what is on the page. Thin sites go to a human.
items.guardrails: If the page has under 300 characters of text, no draft is written and the row is flagged for review. Nothing is sent.

items.name: Inbox triage digest
items.desc: Every morning, sorts unread email into urgent, needs reply, FYI and junk, then sends one short digest to Telegram.
items.guardrails: Reads only subject, sender and the first 500 characters. It never replies, deletes or labels anything.

items.name: Phishing check
items.desc: Scores each new email for phishing from its headers, links and wording, then alerts you only on risky ones.
items.guardrails: Never opens links or attachments. Only extracts link text and domains for the model to judge.

items.name: Receipt extractor
items.desc: Pulls date, vendor and total from emailed receipts into a sheet, and flags anything it is unsure about.
items.guardrails: Writes rows with a confidence flag. Low-confidence rows are marked for manual check, never guessed.

items.name: Support form triage
items.desc: Scores each support form submission for priority, logs it, and pings you on urgent ones.
items.guardrails: Adds a priority and one-line summary. It does not reply to the customer.

items.name: Uptime watch
items.desc: Checks your sites every 5 minutes and alerts once when one goes down, and once when it recovers.
items.guardrails: Keeps state so it alerts on change, not every 5 minutes.

items.name: Video to content pack
items.desc: When a new video appears in a feed, drafts a title, a post and a short thread into a review sheet.
items.guardrails: Drafts land in a sheet with status 'draft'. Nothing is posted automatically.

items.name: Weekly metrics summary
items.desc: Every Monday, reads your tracking sheet, computes the week-on-week change, and sends a short plain-language summary.
items.guardrails: The math is done in code. The model only words the result and cannot change the numbers.
